preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of days N for each test case must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of places K must be between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= K or A[i] == -1 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence A must be either a valid place number between 1 and K or -1.
The total number of days across all test cases must not exceed 1000000.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' if the plan can be completed or 'NO' if it cannot.
If the output is 'YES', the second line must contain N space-separated integers representing the completed plan.

postconditions.expression: all(A[i] != A[i+1] for i in range(N-1) if A[i] != -1 and A[i+1] != -1)
postconditions.description: If the plan is completed, no two consecutive days can have the same place visited.
